Endpoint authentication
When adopting OAuth 2.0 as an authentication method, the below security requirements are needed in order to trigger this endpoint:
The user must fulfill the below security roles requirements; if he fails to obtain access to all the necessary security roles, an
error 403: Insufficient privileges to execute this request
is returned:
The user must acquire access to the following security role:
Tax â Access Forms Product
When the user has access to the below security role, he is able to use the property
customReturnManagerFilterIds
in the request body to filter the results based on the custom filter Id(s) provided. In case the user does not have access to the said security role and he tries to apply a filter, an error 403:
Insufficient privileges to execute this request
is returned:
Tax â Return Manager â Custom Filters - Apply
Whenever the user has access to the below
optional
security role, he is able to get the value of the taxReferenceNumber property for TF documents. In case the user does not have access to the said security role, the taxReferenceNumber property will be returned as empty in all the retrieved documents:
Tax â TF - Return Manager â View Account Number Column
This endpoint validates against the userâs
contact security
and
document visibility
. If the user does not have access to a given document or to the contact associated to this document, the document will not be included in the response body.
Endpoint description
Returns a list of documents with all metadata available in the return manager for a specific year of the TF product.
Note:
Requesting the list of documents for the latest taxation period displayed in the return manager will return the list of documents for all years supported by this version. For example, if the last year currently displayed in the return manager supports 2023 and later, this means that getting the list of documents for 2024 will return the list of documents present in the return manager for the 2023 and later period.
